limitations: The intermittent unresponsive renderer observed on 0.5.58 remains unexplained. Later source, packed and old-version comparison runs did not reproduce it. Do not claim the persistence, Outliner or startup-deadline fixes establish its cause.
Browser unload prompts require user activation and can be overridden. Forced process termination and power loss cannot guarantee an in-flight edit's final save.
History is session-local; worker replacement and direct Blender file/history operations invalidate prior workbench model entries.
World volumes, complete rendering parity, expanded inspection-only editing, game publication and full viewport extraction remain outside this pass.
